_notes.version: Runtime snapshot version; the installer uses it to decide whether a reinstall is needed
_notes.url: Remote runtime.zip download URL (used when the bundled asset is missing); empty means bundled-only
_notes.sha256: Checksum of the remote archive; enforced whenever url is non-empty
_notes.how it is built: The collect-runtime job in .github/workflows/android-build.yml fills url/sha256 before packaging
